title: santolina chamaecyparissus subvar. brevicaulis
intro: Santolina chamaecyparissus subvar. brevicaulis, commonly known as dwarf grey lavender or short-stemmed santolina, is a shrubby perennial herb belonging to the Asteraceae family. This plant is prized for its health benefits, which include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and support the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Santolina chamaecyparissus subvar. brevicaulis include its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antiviral properties, making it useful for treating wounds, skin conditions, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
